svg.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.title: Price Ledger
svg.desc: Commodities across the top, one column each. Rounds down the left, one row each. Every cell is three hollow seven-segment figures and a small box beside them. 6 commodity columns of 31.17mm by 24 rounds of 10mm, every cell 3 hollow seven-segment figures 4.7 x 8.4mm to be filled in with a pencil, and a 6mm move box beside them. No commodity is named on it and no band is tracked on it: a column is not the grain column until somebody stands the grain token in the seat at its head. Generated by tools/build-ledger.mjs from data/ledger.json and data/components.json - do not edit. 210 x 297 mm at 8 units/mm, 3 mm bleed. The ink plate alone is the black-and-white edition.

g.text: Colour the figure in. Strike it through when it changes and fill the next one below.
It is worth what it is worth.
What you do not shift, you lose.
The easy ore came out first.
It is bought because it is going up.
